payload.title: Calibration of the Sr/Ca paleothermometer: A Bayesian approach
payload.summary: This notebook demonstrates the calibration of the Sr/Ca paleothermometer using Bayesian linear regression. It utilizes the PyMC library to infer the posterior distribution of regression parameters, contrasting with a previous frequentist approach. The analysis is performed on coral data from DeLong et al. (2011), focusing on two coral species, *Siderastrea sidera* and *Montastraea faveolata*. The notebook highlights the advantages of Bayesian methods, such as handling uncertainty and incorporating prior knowledge, while also discussing potential pitfalls like the influence of priors.
goals: Calibrate the Sr/Ca paleothermometer using Bayesian statistics.
Compare Bayesian and frequentist regression approaches.
Analyze coral data to infer temperature proxies.
